# Workday

Workday is a cloud-based enterprise resource planning (ERP) software that provides comprehensive solutions for human capital management, financial management, and analytics

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/workday/.

## Actions

- **Create Time Off Request**: Creates a time off request for the specified worker id and initiates the business process.
- **Get Absence Balance** (read-only): Retrieves the specified balance of all absence plan and leave of absence types.
- **Get Balance Details** (read-only): Retrieves the specified balance of all absence plan and leave of absence types.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Retrieves the current authenticated worker's profile information from workday.
- **Get Holiday Events** (read-only): Returns the holiday events for the specified workers and time period.
- **Get Interview Feedback** (read-only): Retrieves feedback entries for a specific interview to prepare debrief notes with highlights and lowlights.
- **Get Job Posting** (read-only): Retrieves detailed information about a specific job posting including job description.
- **Get Job Posting Questionnaire** (read-only): Retrieves screening questions and questionnaires associated with a specific job posting.
- **Get Leave Status Values** (read-only): Retrieves instances that can be used as values for other endpoint parameters in this service.
- **Get My Job Postings** (read-only): Finds all job postings assigned to a specific recruiter by analyzing interviews and job requisitions.
- **Get Prospect** (read-only): Retrieves a single prospect instance for talent matching and best-fit analysis.
- **Get Prospect Educations** (read-only): Retrieves the education of a prospect for talent matching and best-fit analysis.
- **Get Prospect Experiences** (read-only): Retrieves the work experience of a prospect for talent matching and best-fit analysis.
- **Get Prospect Resume Attachments** (read-only): Retrieves resume attachments for a specific prospect to help prepare for upcoming interviews.
- **Get Prospect Skills** (read-only): Retrieves the skills of a prospect for talent matching and best-fit analysis.
- **Get Time Off Status Values** (read-only): Retrieves instances that can be used as values for other endpoint parameters in this service.
- **Get Worker Eligible Absence Types** (read-only): Retrieves a collection of eligible absence types for the specified worker.
- **Get Worker Leaves of Absence** (read-only): Retrieves the leaves of absence for the specified worker using the working absencemanagement v1 api.
- **Get Worker Time Off Details** (read-only): Retrieves a collection of time off details for the specified worker.
- **Get Worker Valid Time Off Dates** (read-only): Retrieves the valid time off dates for the specified worker id for the given dates.
- **List Absence Balances** (read-only): Retrieves the balance of all absence plan and leave of absence type for the specified worker id.
- **List Balances** (read-only): Retrieves the balance of all absence plan and leave of absence type for the specified worker id.
- **List Interviews** (read-only): Retrieves a list of interviews with job requisition and recruiter assignment details.
- **List Job Postings** (read-only): Retrieves a list of job postings from workday recruiting system with filtering options.
- **List Workers** (read-only): Retrieves a collection of workers and current staffing information.
